facts.fact: AICTE Pragati scholarship lasts up to 4 years for degree students (admitted in first year)
facts.quote: Maximum of 4 years duration for first year admitted Degree students and maximum of 3 years for Diploma Students.

facts.fact: AICTE Pragati scholarship lasts up to 3 years for diploma students
facts.quote: Maximum of 4 years duration for first year admitted Degree students and maximum of 3 years for Diploma Students.

facts.fact: The scholarship is renewed for each next year of study through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
facts.quote: The scholarship will be renewed for the next year of study on receipt of renewal through National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

facts.fact: Renewal needs a promotion certificate certified by the Head of Institution, submitted on the online portal
facts.quote: by submitting Promotion Certificate duly certified by the Head of Institution in the online portal.

summary: Pragati FAQ on NSP confirms 4 years (degree) / 3 years (diploma) and yearly NSP renewal with a Head-of-Institution promotion certificate.
